description: The chart illustrates a comparison of normalized performance scores across several Korean evaluation benchmarks for three language models. The horizontal axis contains the benchmark categories labeled (left to right) PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, presented in that order; the vertical axis is an unlabeled linear scale with values shown directly as numeric annotations on the bars, spanning from about 0.42 up to 1.00. Each category displays a grouped set of three vertical bars: RedWhale (our) in dark purple, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) in light gray. For PT-EVAL, the bars are approximately 0.42 (purple), 0.46 (light blue), and 1.00 (gray); for KoBEST-BQ they are about 0.52, 0.56, and 1.00; for KoBEST-CP about 0.71, 0.74, and 1.00; for KoBEST-HS about 0.50, 0.54, and 1.00; for KoBEST-SN about 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00; and for AVG about 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The bars are grouped by benchmark with consistent color coding indicated by the legend below the plot, and the gray SOLAR baseline bars are all annotated at 1.00; the categories are not shown as sorted by bar height, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the value labels above each bar.
